title: Empty a capsule machine's collector and load a fresh capsule
instruction: Clear the used capsules into the recycling tub and restore the capsule machine with its collection bin fitted, the fresh capsule correctly seated, and its head fully closed. Release both hands when finished.
context: Emptying the used-pod collector and reloading after ejection are routine capsule-machine maintenance. The task requires handling a loose container, disposing of its contents and restoring it before loading and closing the head.
setup: Calibrated two-arm YAM bench. Anchored polymer/metal capsule mechanism, 280×210×290 mm, with passive hinged head; removable polymer cassette, inner 120×82×65 mm, 2 mm walls, 65 g and 30×55×24 mm pull bar. Six spent aluminium/polymer capsule envelopes start in a 3×2 cassette layer; one is in the carrier. Capsules: 24–33 mm body diameter, 26 mm height, 37 mm flange; spent 12 g, fresh 8 g. Fresh capsule on a 70 mm polymer pedestal; fixed polymer recycling tray, inner 300×300×55 mm, on the left. Fixed modules, guides and exact coordinates: setup-layout.json and README.md.
scoring: 0.35: all seven used capsules contained at rest in recycling tray. 0.65: collector also fitted within 9 mm, upright cosine >0.99. 1: fresh seated within 3.5 mm horizontally/3 mm vertically and upright cosine >0.99; head <4 degrees closed; loose bodies below 15 mm/s and stable within 2 mm/2 degrees over 1 s; grippers open >40 mm and robot bodies >3 mm clear for 1 s. Drop/invalid: 0.
reset_notes: Restore all bodies and passive joints to the fixed reset and settle before scoring. No consumables in simulation.
fidelity: Original cold, unpowered cutaway mechanism at household scale. Native rigid cups, passive over-centre head, lifting fork and removable collector use contact physics. Capsule deformation and the water circuit are outside this mechanical clearing/reloading task.
